experiment_data.hypothesis: exp14 cross-LLM failure is driven by high false positive rate on Llama benign (model classifies unfamiliar Llama benign text as jailbreak). exp14b control should show near-zero FP on Qwen benign with maintained TP on Llama jailbreak, confirming benign distribution coverage as the bottleneck.

metrics.key_finding: TP rates identical across exp14/exp14b. FP rate on Llama benign 88-100% vs Qwen benign 0%. F1 collapse 100% caused by FP explosion, jailbreak detection fully cross-LLM transferable.
